executive_summary: Priya shows strong foundational core engineering capabilities with 3+ years of experience working with backend frameworks and classical machine learning models. However, she has limited direct exposure to building large-scale modern GenAI production apps, vector data structures, or advanced agentic loops.
strengths: Strong Python programming and test-driven architecture background.
Excellent SQL database management and structural query tuning history.
Solid REST API development using FastAPI and cloud deployment patterns.
gaps: Lacks production experience deploying large language model (LLM) workflows.
No explicit mention or evidence of working with orchestrator toolkits like LangChain or CrewAI.
Missing background in advanced vector search, embedding optimization, or semantic caching strategies.
interview_focus_areas: Evaluate her theoretical knowledge of LLM integration parameters and context window management.
Verify her willingness and capacity to quickly upskill in multi-agent orchestration frameworks.

interview_questions.question: You have built extensive REST APIs with FastAPI. How would you design an API to handle streaming text responses from an LLM chat endpoint efficiently?
interview_questions.intent: Verify ability to adapt standard backend architecture skills to meet performance needs of GenAI applications.

interview_questions.question: Can you explain the main architectural differences between a standard relational database query and a semantic similarity vector search?
interview_questions.intent: Test conceptual baseline understanding of vector storage dynamics despite a lack of direct production exposure.

evidence.python_programming: Maintained clean enterprise backend engines using FastAPI for 3 years at DataTech Solutions.
evidence.sql_database_skills: Optimized complex analytical queries and migration schemas across PostgreSQL instances.
evidence.llm_application_development: Limited to local experimentation using open-source models via Hugging Face pipelines.

human_review_note: A very capable software engineer who easily checks our baseline system programming boxes. She will require additional training and ramp-up time on our specific multi-agent AI stack.
